title: AAI Junior Executive & Manager Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Junior Executive and Manager posts in ATC, Electronics, Engineering, Airport Operations and other streams as per AAI advt
qualification: Engineering degree / other professional qualifications post-wise as per AAI notification
ageLimit: Post-wise upper age as per AAI JE/Manager advertisement
applicationFee: As per AAI online application fee
selectionProcess: Online Exam / Interview (post-wise) → Document Verification → Medical
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.aai.aero Careers
2. Open Junior Executive / Manager recruitment
3. Register and apply online
4. Pay fee and upload documents
5. Submit before last date
shortDescription: AAI Junior Executive & Manager Online Form 2026 – apply for airport sector posts on aai.aero careers portal.
content:
Airports Authority of India (AAI) recruits Junior Executives and Managers in technical and non-technical disciplines.

Candidates should check the latest AAI advertisement for vacancy numbers, discipline-wise eligibility and exam pattern. Apply only through aai.aero careers section.
